name: Impact Whey Protein
ingredients_raw: Whey Protein Concentrate (93.1%) (Emulsifiers: Soy lecithin & Sunflower lecithin), Natural & Nature Identical & Artificial Flavours (Mango), Natural Colour (Beta Carotene), Sweetener (Sucralose). ALLERGENS: Contains Milk and Soy. Manufactured in a facility which processes Oats, Wheat and Nuts. THIS CONTAINS SUCRALOSE. CONTAINS NON-CALORIC SWEETENER. INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE: Protein contributes to the growth & maintenance of muscle mass, so to reap the benefits of MYPROTEIN 4671 this product we recommend adding 30g (approx 1 scoop) to 250ml of water or milk, consume 30 minutes before and/or after your exercise. Recommended Usage: 30g (approx. 1 scoop) per day. IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This product is not to be used as a substitute for a varied diet. This product is intended to be used alongside an active lifestyle and a balanced diet.
